evidence.claim: The external research context frames the AI optical supply chain as moving from GPU and switches down to optics, lasers, wafers, epitaxy and tools, with Aixtron as an example of an indirect tool-layer beneficiary; this supports searching for US-listed analogs such as Veeco and AXT.
evidence.source_title: Aixtron: The Toolmaker Behind the Optical Bottleneck

memory_update.text: VECO should be promoted to the underfollowed discovery lane for this node because it has direct, recent order evidence for InP laser manufacturing tools tied to AI optical interconnect demand.

AXTI should be tracked as a speculative-to-core underfollowed substrate candidate; the InP substrate linkage is strong, but China export permits, cyclicality and customer concentration require later-layer diligence.

COHR and LITE are better used as reference demand validators than primary underfollowed alpha names; their capacity, backlog and product-cycle commentary can confirm or falsify upstream wafer/tool bottleneck claims.

No pure-play US-listed Aixtron equivalent was found in this focused pass; Veeco appears to be the closest US-listed equipment-layer mapping, while Aixtron remains an important non-US reference toolmaker.

Later passes should separately test MACOM, Semtech, Tower Semiconductor, Fabrinet, Applied Optoelectronics, POET Technologies and GlobalFoundries as adjacent component, foundry, manufacturing or module-layer exposures, but they were excluded here to keep the direct upstream node list capped at four.

node: AI optical connectivity production chain: lasers, compound-semiconductor epitaxy, wafers, and epitaxy tools
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the AI optical connectivity upstream node. The cleanest US-listed underfollowed exposures found in this pass are Veeco at the epitaxy/tool layer and AXT at the InP substrate layer. Coherent and Lumentum are included as reference optical/laser leaders because they sit closer to the visible AI datacenter optics demand and help validate whether upstream tool and wafer demand is truly AI-linked. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
